semantics: eligibility: quickLogFor(questions) -> null | {kind: 'chips', key, options: active options in order} | {kind: 'number', key}.

initial: initialNumber(question, last) -> the text a number quick-log starts with: String(last) (JS Number::toString) when last is a number the question still accepts, else String(min) when min >= 0, else ''. Non-numbers (strings, booleans, lists, null) count as no last value.
